candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: Type I cryoglobulinemia (evidenced by elevated cryocrit, monoclonal IgG-κ, intravascular cryoglobulin/fibrin thrombi on biopsy, purpuric skin lesions) associated with multiple myeloma (80% plasma cells, lytic lesions, monoclonal IgG-κ). C001 captures only the myeloma component and its skeletal manifestation, missing the cryoglobulinemia diagnosis that is central to the clinical presentation and the reason for the biopsy and workup.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the underlying plasma cell dyscrasia (multiple myeloma with lytic lesions) but omits the Type I cryoglobulinemia component, which is the defining cutaneous/vascular manifestation and an essential part of the composite diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Composite diagnosis required: both Type I cryoglobulinemia AND multiple myeloma must be named for complete equivalence
